tasks.title: SQLite state store with idempotency
tasks.description: Durable runs, actions, budgets tables with WAL and synchronous=FULL.
tasks.details:
src/jangus/kernel/state.py: schema v1, transactional intent+attempt charge, idempotency keys, schema version check. Port from v1 execution/storage.py.

[2026-11-02T11:43:34-05:00] Plan: stacked on phase-1/config-and-errors (PR #3 unmerged). Add 4 FaultCodes (state_unavailable, state_schema_mismatch, idempotency_conflict, budget_exceeded). kernel/state.py: StateStore over sqlite3 (WAL, synchronous=FULL, foreign_keys, autocommit with explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE), schema v1 (meta, runs, actions, budgets), create_run idempotent by key, record_intent = one transaction inserting the action and charging the budget (same key+payload returns existing without charge; different payload = conflict; over budget = fault with no insert), record_result, budgets persist across reopen, any sqlite write error blocks all further writes (fail closed). Tests in tests/test_state.py.
